description: Search for hotels in a city/destination on a date range, returning a list of properties with prices, ratings, and availability. Probe for URL-parameter shortcuts that skip the homepage UI (Booking exposes ?ss={city}&checkin={date}&checkout={date} on /searchresults.html — verify it still works).

Search for one-way or round-trip flights between two airports on given dates. Return structured results with price, airline, and duration. Kayak deep-links via /flights/{ORIGIN}-{DEST}/{YYYY-MM-DD} — confirm and capture the URL pattern.

Search GitHub repositories by keyword and language. The /search?q={query}+language%3A{lang}&type=repositories endpoint is well-documented; capture it as fastest_path plus a fallback recipe that drives the search bar UI. Extraction should pull repo name, description, stars, and primary language from result cards.
